name: trama
description: See your System as a layered Model of state machines, review Proposals and Drifts, and steer your coding agent from one editor tab.

commands.title: Send to agent (closing the tab sends it too)

trama.theme.markdownDescription: Colours of the Trama panel. Auto (the default) follows the editor's theme; Light and Dark fix it.

enumDescriptions: omp in the editor's integrated terminal, in every editor.
trama.agent.markdownDescription: The agent Trama starts: `cursor` (Cursor's chat, only in Cursor; the default) or `omp` (in the editor's terminal, in any editor).

trama.ompPath.markdownDescription: Path of the `omp` program used to suggest model names. Empty uses `omp` from the editor's PATH.

enumDescriptions: A terminal tab in the active editor group.
trama.terminalLocation.markdownDescription: Where `omp` terminals open: `panel` (the terminal area; the default) or `editor` (a tab in the active editor group).

trama.ignoreInstructionFiles.markdownDescription: With omp: Trama's jobs ignore agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules, .omp/RULES.md) in the project and your user folders. Off by default.

trama.submitWhileRunning.markdownDescription: Let a run start while another run started by Trama is in progress. Off by default.

trama.analysis.markdownDescription: Model for design work: design requests, Resolve Drifts and import. Empty (the default) keeps the agent's default model.

trama.scan.markdownDescription: Model for scans and the sub-agents that compare Machines, also in each Run's pre-flight. Empty (the default) keeps the agent's default model.

trama.execution.markdownDescription: Model for implementing Tasks, in single runs and Run all. Empty (the default) keeps the agent's default model.

trama.autoExit.markdownDescription: Close the agent's terminal as soon as the agent is idle or its command ends (default on).

trama.maxParallelAgents.markdownDescription: How many sub-agents the agent may run at once (default 20). Agents without sub-agents ignore it.

trama.skillsDir.markdownDescription: Folder, relative to the project root, where Trama installs the agent skills.

trama.language.markdownDescription: Language the agent writes in, for example `Italian`; code stays in English. Empty (the default) asks nothing about language.

trama.experimentalDriftBlocker.markdownDescription: Experimental. On: a new Drift blocks only the Tasks it really affects; one that blocks none arrives as a resolution Proposal.

trama.experimentalAdvisorScanner.markdownDescription: Experimental. On: during every Run an advisor, using the Scan model, checks the code against the Model and files Drifts; all scans are off.

trama.experimentalParallelExecution.markdownDescription: Experimental. On: in a run of several Tasks the agent may start together Tasks that concern the same thing, giving a reason.

trama.experimentalAsyncDriftResolver.markdownDescription: Experimental. On: the agent prepares each Drift's resolution question, so `Resolve` asks it at once without starting an agent.

trama.experimentalContextSharing.markdownDescription: Experimental. On: the agent passes its sub-agents what it has already read about their work, so they do not read it again.
